name: Financial Accounting
description: Recording and reporting a firm's financial transactions for external users.

name: Financial Reporting
description: Preparing financial statements in accordance with accounting standards.

name: Revenue Recognition
description: Determining when and how much revenue should be recognized in the accounts.

name: Asset Accounting
description: Measuring and reporting tangible and intangible assets, including depreciation and impairment.

name: Liability and Equity Accounting
description: Accounting for debt, leases, and shareholders' equity.

name: Consolidated Financial Statements
description: Combining the financial statements of a parent and its subsidiaries.

name: Financial Statement Analysis
description: Evaluating a company's performance and position using ratios and other analytical tools.

name: Earnings Management
description: The use of accounting choices and judgment to influence reported earnings.

name: International Financial Reporting Standards
description: The global accounting standards issued by the IASB.

name: Managerial Accounting
description: Accounting information for internal planning, control, and decision making.

name: Cost Accounting
description: Measuring and analyzing the costs of products, services, and activities.

name: Job Costing
description: Assigning costs to distinct, customized jobs or batches.

name: Process Costing
description: Assigning costs to continuous, homogeneous production processes.

name: Activity-Based Costing
description: Assigning overhead to products based on the activities that drive costs.

name: Standard Costing
description: Using predetermined costs as benchmarks for planning and control.

name: Cost-Volume-Profit Analysis
description: Analyzing how costs, volume, and prices affect profit.

name: Budgeting
description: Preparing financial plans that allocate resources and set performance targets.

name: Variance Analysis
description: Comparing actual results to budgets or standards and explaining differences.

name: Performance Measurement
description: Evaluating unit and manager performance using financial and non-financial metrics.

name: Strategic Management Accounting
description: Accounting information oriented to competitive strategy and customer value.

name: Auditing
description: The independent examination of financial information to express an opinion on its fairness.

name: External Audit
description: The independent audit of financial statements for shareholders and the public.

name: Internal Audit
description: In-house assurance over risk management, controls, and governance.

name: Operational Audit
description: Reviewing the efficiency and effectiveness of operations.

name: Compliance Audit
description: Verifying adherence to laws, regulations, and contractual requirements.

name: Information Technology Audit
description: Assessing controls and risks in information systems.

name: Continuous Auditing
description: Automated, near-real-time assurance using embedded analytics.

name: Taxation
description: The accounting for and planning of taxes owed to government authorities.

name: Corporate Taxation
description: Taxation of business profits and the related compliance and planning.

name: Individual Taxation
description: Taxation of personal income, deductions, and credits.

name: Indirect Taxation
description: Taxation of transactions through VAT, GST, and sales taxes.

name: International Taxation
description: Tax rules for cross-border income and double taxation treaties.

name: Transfer Pricing
description: Pricing transactions between related entities across tax jurisdictions.

name: Tax Compliance
description: Meeting tax filing, payment, and reporting obligations accurately and on time.

name: Forensic Accounting
description: Applying accounting and investigative skills to disputes, fraud, and litigation.

name: Fraud Examination
description: Detecting and investigating fraud, embezzlement, and financial misstatement.

name: Litigation Support
description: Providing accounting expertise and damages calculations in legal proceedings.

name: Asset Tracing
description: Locating and following the movement of assets, including hidden or diverted funds.

name: Bankruptcy Accounting
description: Accounting for insolvent entities and the recovery of assets for creditors.

name: Accounting Information Systems
description: Systems and controls for capturing, processing, and reporting accounting data.

name: Internal Controls
description: Policies and procedures safeguarding assets and ensuring reliable reporting.

name: XBRL Reporting
description: Tagging financial data in a machine-readable reporting language.

name: Data Analytics in Accounting
description: Using analytics and automation to improve audit, reporting, and decision making.

name: Public Sector Accounting
description: Accounting for government and public-sector entities using fund and budgetary concepts.

name: Fund Accounting
description: Accounting that tracks resources segregated by purpose into separate funds.

name: Budgetary Accounting
description: Accounting that integrates and reports against approved budgets.

name: Nonprofit Accounting
description: Accounting for not-for-profit organizations and their restricted resources.

name: Sustainability Accounting
description: Measuring and reporting environmental and social performance alongside financial results.

name: Environmental Accounting
description: Accounting for environmental costs, liabilities, and resource use.

name: Carbon Accounting
description: Measuring, reporting, and managing greenhouse gas emissions.

name: Integrated Reporting
description: Reporting financial and non-financial performance as a connected whole.

name: Accounting Theory
description: The conceptual foundations and principles underlying accounting practice.

name: Normative Accounting Theory
description: Theories prescribing what accounting should measure and report.

name: Positive Accounting Theory
description: Theories explaining and predicting actual accounting choices and behavior.

name: Accounting History
description: The study of the historical development of accounting thought and practice.
